title: NeoNect v1.0.0 Production Release

implement complete Danisa API E2EE relay messaging, background poll/ack sync, device key retrieval, and friends DM system
lazy load fullscreen video and image components in MediaLightboxModal
synchronize and update user online status in chat in real-time
implement functional idle, DND, invisible presence states and UI cleanups
show transfer progress on sender client with standard units (KB, MB, GB)
sync authoritative friends list from server on login and update
transfer binary payload for media files across isolated environments and platforms
add multi-client dockerized desktop environment with Qt 6.7 and noVNC
support native media rendering, direct transmission, and message retry
overhaul entry brand header, integrate NeoNect assets, and remove gateway window controls
hide members panel for direct messages and implement seen checkmark read receipts
restore pill-shaped online status indicator and add unread message count badges
implement real-time typing indicators and message sending states
determine user online status by server connectivity via native WebSocket
